Design Considerations
This freeway facility will be designed to have full control of access along its entire route. Access to it will be provided at interchange locations at I-94, at the air terminal facilities located directly west of General Mitchell Field, and at the air cargo facility immediately west of Howell Avenue. Fences will be constructed for the safety of pedestrians and to keep domestic animals off the freeway.
Since the freeway will be in embankment for it; entire length, the local through streets will be bridged, thereby allowing local community circulation to continue unimpaired. It will permit local fire and health protection, bussing of school children, access to churches, and private enterprise service routes to function efficiently.
General Mitchell Field, existing Grange Avenue east of 6th Street will be vacated for the development of their 60 acre air cargo area. Grange Avenue will be relocated to the north and will connect with Howell Avenue as part of a freeway-airport coordinated design. This will provide access to abutting properties and give impetus to local growth. An interior street system east of Howell Avenue will provide circulation to the various terminal facilities.
There will be little disturbance of public utilities.

Alterations to the Wisconsin Electric Power Company's high voltage transmission tower lines will be required west of the C.M.St.P. & P. R.R.
The freeway will be in embankment section and adequate drainage facilities will be provided.
